versions.changelog:
investment-research-analyst v1.0.0

- Initial release of a multi-agent investment research framework simulating a professional trading firm.
- Provides end-to-end workflow: multidimensional data gathering, bull/bear debate, risk assessment, fact checking, and report generation.
- Covers analysis across fundamentals, news, sentiment, technicals, risks, and more, outputting structured professional reports.
- Supports A股/港股 (via akshare) and US stocks (via yfinance), using both public data sources and third-party research.
- Includes interactive dashboard design requirements and deployment steps.
